title: Garden Salad
instructions: Chop the vegetables and toss in a bowl. Dress with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Spinach Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs and pour into a buttered pan. Add spinach and cheese, fold, and cook until set.

title: Banana Oatmeal
instructions: Simmer oats in milk until creamy. Top with sliced banana and a drizzle of honey.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Sear sliced chicken, then stir-fry with broccoli and pepper in soy sauce. Serve over rice.

title: Baked Salmon and Greens
instructions: Roast salmon and asparagus with olive oil at 200°C for 12 minutes. Finish with lemon juice.

title: Yogurt Berry Parfait
instructions: Layer yogurt with berries in a glass. Top with crumbled granola bars.

title: Veggie Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta and sauté garlic, tomato and zucchini in olive oil. Toss together and top with parmesan.

title: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown the beef with spices. Serve in tortillas with shredded lettuce, tomato and cheese.

title: Fruit Smoothie
instructions: Blend banana, frozen berries and milk until smooth. Sweeten with honey to taste.

title: Avocado Toast
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon juice onto toasted bread. Top with a fried or poached egg.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter the bread, fill with cheese, and grill in a pan until golden and melted.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Stir-fry shrimp, then add cold rice, peas and beaten egg. Season with soy sauce.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Simmer tomatoes with sautéed onion and garlic, then blend. Stir in a splash of cream.

title: Roast Chicken Dinner
instructions: Roast chicken with chopped potatoes, carrots and onion at 200°C for 40 minutes.

title: Greek Yogurt Bowl
instructions: Spoon yogurt into a bowl and top with sliced kiwi, almonds and honey.

title: Tuna Salad Sandwich
instructions: Mix tuna with mayo and diced celery. Pile onto bread with crisp lettuce.

title: Kale and Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Massage kale with lemon and oil, then toss with cooked quinoa. Top with sliced avocado.

title: Pork Chops with Apples
instructions: Pan-sear pork chops, then soften sliced apple and onion in the same pan. Serve together.

title: Veggie Omelette
instructions: Sauté the vegetables, pour over beaten eggs, and cook. Fold with mozzarella inside.

title: Fish Tacos
instructions: Pan-fry seasoned tilapia and flake into tortillas. Top with shredded cabbage, lime and sour cream.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Layer sliced tomato and mozzarella. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and basil.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
instructions: Spread peanut butter on toast and top with banana slices. Finish with a drizzle of honey.

title: Chicken Noodle Bowl
instructions: Simmer chicken with carrot, celery and onion in broth. Add pasta and cook until tender.

title: Tofu Veggie Stir-Fry
instructions: Crisp cubed tofu in a hot pan, then stir-fry with vegetables and soy sauce. Serve on brown rice.

title: Baked Sweet Potato
instructions: Bake sweet potato at 200°C for 45 minutes. Split and top with butter or a dollop of greek yogurt.

title: Berry Overnight Oats
instructions: Mix oats with milk and yogurt and refrigerate overnight. Top with raspberries and honey.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Sauté shrimp in garlic butter and toss with cooked pasta. Brighten with lemon juice.

title: Hummus Veggie Wrap
instructions: Spread hummus on a tortilla and layer with sliced vegetables. Roll tightly and halve.

title: Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Pulse cauliflower into rice-sized bits and stir-fry with peas and egg. Season with soy sauce.

title: Cheesy Baked Potato
instructions: Bake potato until fluffy, then load with cheese, sour cream and crumbled bacon.

title: Melon Fruit Salad
instructions: Cube the fruit and toss together. Squeeze lime over the top and chill before serving.

title: Salmon Rice Bowl
instructions: Flake cooked salmon over rice with sliced avocado and cucumber. Season with soy sauce.
